ARO - All Races Open - Changelog

v1.2 (2026-11-17)
- Get To Callahan and Round Trip load again. They have 11 opponents and the game
  couldn't load that many swapped cars so the race never started. In those two
  races opponents now keep their own cars (KeepOpponentsIn in scripts/ARO.ini)
- New MenuKey setting in scripts/ARO.ini to open the menu with another key if F5
  doesn't work on your keyboard, for example MenuKey=Insert
- Less work every frame, which should fix the FPS drop some players saw on Windows.
  Empty gamepad slots are checked every 2 seconds instead of every frame and nothing
  is drawn while the menu is closed
- The log doesn't write to disk for every parked or traffic car any more
- Updating from v1.1: replace scripts/ARO.asi and scripts/ARO.ini

v1.1 (2026-11-15)
- Full keyboard and gamepad control for the menu
- L3+R3 opens and closes the menu on a gamepad
- The game ignores your keys and buttons while the menu is open
- Pinned races wrap onto a new line
- Type filter now has Drift Attack and Smash And Grab
- Removed the By type sort
- The zip now includes ThirteenAG's Ultimate ASI Loader (dinput8.dll)

v1.0 (2026-11-15)
- First release
- Every race works with every car
- F5 menu with all races plus search, filters and pins for EasyDrive
- Choose your opponents from your class, any class or a real world match
- Jack spots, parked cars and Most Wanted races are left alone
